info.title: Airlabs Universal API
info.description: Aviation data API for real-time flights, schedules, flight details, airports, airlines, routes, fleets, countries, time zones, tax codes, nearby airport lookup, and destination suggestions.

post.description: Creates a flight alert listener in Airlabs.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

webhookUrl.description: Server URL to receive incoming flight alert webhook updates.

flightNumber.description: Listen for changes by flight number.

airlineIata.description: Listen for changes by airline IATA code.

airlineIcao.description: Listen for changes by airline ICAO code.

depIata.description: Listen for changes by departure airport IATA code.

depIcao.description: Listen for changes by departure airport ICAO code.

depDate.description: Listen for changes by departure date.

depTime.description: Listen for changes by departure time.

arrIata.description: Listen for changes by arrival airport IATA code.

arrIcao.description: Listen for changes by arrival airport ICAO code.

arrDate.description: Listen for changes by arrival date.

arrTime.description: Listen for changes by arrival time.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to listen for, or leave empty to listen for all changes.
